patterns.note: Full-bleed hero image with overlaid text and statistics, transitioning to a grid-based layout for features, testimonials, and informational sections.
A strong contrast between elegant, high-contrast serif headings and clean, legible sans-serif body text, creating a sophisticated yet accessible feel.
A warm, muted color palette featuring a deep charcoal/dark grey, off-white, and a distinctive burnt orange/terracotta accent, complemented by light beige section backgrounds.

The hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, scrolling slower than the foreground content. The navigation bar transforms from transparent to a sticky, solid white bar with a smaller logo and dark text upon scroll.
Alternating background colors (dark, light beige, white) are used to visually separate major content sections, enhancing readability and content segmentation.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a large background image that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a depth-of-field parallax effect. This can be achieved by adjusting the background-position or using CSS transforms on scroll.

The primary navigation bar is initially transparent and fixed at the top. Upon scrolling past the hero section, it transitions to a sticky state with a solid background color, a subtle shadow, and a reduced height, while the logo scales down and text color changes.

Sections are revealed with scroll-triggered animations, likely using a library like locomotive-scroll. Elements within sections appear to fade in or slide up into view as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic content loading experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body size) with generous line height, complemented by clean, legible sans-serif body text and smaller, uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons, input fields, and some card elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, especially in the hero and between major sections, with content within feature grids being more dense but still well-padded.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its sophisticated blend of an elegant serif typeface with a modern sans-serif, paired with a warm, muted color palette. This combination, along with subtle parallax motion in the hero, creates a high-trust, editorial, and premium feel that elevates it beyond typical health service sites.
